name: COLONEL FANSHAWE
whenNote: Errata 68 D: on the funeral day the office is drawn without him; he is up the hill. He never leaves his office except for funerals (doc 57).
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the carpet before the desk's left end, clear of his welcoming hand (errata 84 C).
note: COLONEL ABSALOM FANSHAWE, President of the Consolation Improvement Company, at his desk (doc 04: 'warm, generous, expansive, unfailingly courteous'). Canon gives him no appearance but his portrait's ('painted at approximately twice life size and one-third his actual age'), so he is a portly, prosperous gentleman of about sixty with the portrait's moustache -- silver hair and whiskers, a black frock coat, a brocade waistcoat, a gold watch chain (errata 84 B). Drawn first in room-11's composition master beside Thad (style gate step 1), then alone on magenta in five poses (room-11 operation 3), keyed by tools/art/room11-fanshawe.py. BEHIND THE DESK: the sheet stops at the desk top's back edge, so `y` is the cut row, not his feet.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Fanshawe.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest (hands on his waistcoat) · 1 breath (derived from rest by tools/rig/ambient-breath.py) · 2 welcome, his hand open · 3 the watch · 4 laughing. Breathing on 0 and 1 at `rate`; every `breakEvery` seconds one break from the pool (errata 35 and 77: a deliberate action at least every 30 s). He welcomes as he talks.
